title: In-place migration re-injection silently underpays stakers when the new yield strategy haircuts deposits
description: InPlaceMigrator.migrateIn debits each parked user's principal accounting by the requested amount but re-credits the user only by the amount the new yield strategy actually books on the deposit leg. The migrator zeroes parked[token][user] and decrements totalParked by the full requested amt (InPlaceMigrator.sol:215-217), then forwards that same amt to staker.depositFor (L223). Inside StableStaker.depositFor (L630-634) the user's recorded principal is increased only by _routeDeposit's returned credited value, which a haircutting (market/AMM/fee-bearing ERC4626) re-injection strategy reduces to credited < amt. The lost amt - credited is irrecoverable: no residual parked balance, no event, no revert. M-07's economic vector (rate/requested-vs-execution deposit slippage on a haircutting strategy) is re-expressed through the sanctioned migrateIn door after the empty-pool gate closed the setYieldStrategy door.
impact: Per-user principal loss of (amt - credited) on the re-injection deposit leg. Not direct external-attacker theft; gated on the operator wiring a haircutting re-injection strategy (idle/direct/par/1:1-ERC4626 targets preserve principal exactly). Value leak with stated assumptions and external requirements (C4 Medium). Law-2 faithfulness gap (breaks the migrator's stated AC-1 'credit each user the exact principal parked for them', InPlaceMigrator.sol:168) and Law-3 non-obvious owner footgun (operator reaching for a 'safe rewire' tool onto a haircutting target is surprised).
attackPath: Operator runs the in-place flow (initiateMigration -> batchMigrate parks principal in migrator).
Operator resets pool and wires a haircutting (market/AMM/fee'd-ERC4626) strategy via setYieldStrategy on the empty pool.
Operator calls migrateIn: it zeroes parked[user] by full amt and calls depositFor(token, user, amt).
depositFor pulls full amt but _routeDeposit returns credited < amt (strategy haircut); user.amount += credited.
Each re-injected user is permanently short amt - credited; totalParked is driven to 0 despite the shortfall.
recommendation: On the re-injection leg, account the user by the credited return of depositFor / _routeDeposit (not the requested amt): either capture depositFor's effective credited amount and only zero parked[user] / decrement totalParked by that credited amount (retaining the residual as still-parked for a corrective re-injection), or revert when credited < amt so the shortfall cannot be silently absorbed. Safe-config guidance: only re-inject through a par/1:1 (idle/direct/1:1-ERC4626) strategy; never wire a haircutting market/AMM/fee-bearing strategy as the migrateIn target.
